Vata.summary: Vata imbalance leads to dryness, anxiety, and irregular digestion. These remedies focus on warmth, grounding, and nourishment.

remedies.title: Warm & Nourishing Foods
remedies.description: Favour warm, cooked meals like soups, stews, and porridges. Include healthy fats like ghee, sesame oil, and avocados. Avoid raw, cold, and dry foods.
remedies.howTo: Start your day with warm oatmeal cooked in milk with a teaspoon of ghee, cinnamon, and cardamom.

remedies.title: Ginger-Tulsi Tea
remedies.description: A warming herbal tea that calms the nervous system and aids digestion. Ginger reduces bloating while Tulsi relieves stress.
remedies.howTo: Boil 1 cup water with 1-inch fresh ginger and 5 tulsi leaves for 5 minutes. Strain, add honey, and drink warm twice daily.

remedies.title: Abhyanga (Self-Massage)
remedies.description: Warm sesame oil massage calms the nervous system, improves circulation, moisturizes dry skin, and deeply grounds Vata energy.
remedies.howTo: Warm 2-3 tablespoons of sesame oil. Massage your entire body using long strokes on limbs and circular motions on joints. Wait 15 minutes, then take a warm shower.

remedies.title: Ashwagandha Milk
remedies.description: Ashwagandha is an adaptogenic herb that reduces anxiety, promotes restful sleep, and strengthens the body — perfect for Vata imbalance.
remedies.howTo: Mix ½ teaspoon ashwagandha powder in a cup of warm milk with a pinch of nutmeg and honey. Drink before bedtime.

remedies.title: Grounding Yoga & Meditation
remedies.description: Slow, steady yoga poses like Tree Pose, Warrior II, and Child's Pose help ground restless Vata energy. Pair with Nadi Shodhana (alternate nostril breathing).
remedies.howTo: Practice 20 minutes of gentle yoga followed by 10 minutes of alternate nostril breathing every morning.

remedies.title: Triphala for Digestion
remedies.description: Triphala is a gentle herbal formula that regulates bowel movements and detoxifies the digestive tract — essential for Vata's irregular digestion.
remedies.howTo: Mix ½ teaspoon Triphala powder in warm water. Drink 30 minutes before bedtime on an empty stomach.

remedies.title: Establish a Daily Routine
remedies.description: Vata thrives on regularity. Eating, sleeping, and waking at consistent times reduces anxiety and restores balance.
remedies.howTo: Wake at 6 AM, eat meals at fixed times (8 AM, 12:30 PM, 6:30 PM), and sleep by 10 PM. Avoid skipping meals.

remedies.title: Warm Herbal Bath
remedies.description: A warm bath infused with calming herbs like lavender and chamomile soothes Vata's restlessness and promotes deep relaxation.
remedies.howTo: Add 5 drops of lavender essential oil and 1 cup of Epsom salt to a warm bath. Soak for 20 minutes before bed.

Pitta.summary: Pitta imbalance causes excess heat, inflammation, irritability, and skin issues. These remedies focus on cooling, calming, and soothing.

remedies.title: Cooling & Fresh Foods
remedies.description: Favour sweet, bitter, and astringent tastes. Include cucumbers, melons, leafy greens, coconut, and dairy. Avoid spicy, oily, and fried foods.
remedies.howTo: Prepare a daily cooling salad with cucumber, mint, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime. Use coconut oil for cooking instead of mustard oil.

remedies.title: Mint-Fennel Cooler
remedies.description: A refreshing herbal drink that cools internal heat, aids digestion, and reduces acidity — a natural antidote for Pitta fire.
remedies.howTo: Steep 1 teaspoon fennel seeds and 8-10 fresh mint leaves in hot water for 7 minutes. Let it cool to room temperature. Drink 2-3 times daily.

remedies.title: Coconut Oil Massage
remedies.description: Coconut oil has natural cooling properties. A gentle massage reduces body heat, calms inflammation, and nourishes Pitta skin.
remedies.howTo: Apply room-temperature coconut oil to your scalp and body. Massage gently for 10 minutes. Leave for 30 minutes, then shower with cool-to-lukewarm water.

remedies.title: Shatavari & Amla Tonic
remedies.description: Shatavari cools and nourishes, while Amla (Indian Gooseberry) is rich in Vitamin C and reduces excess Pitta heat and acidity.
remedies.howTo: Mix ½ teaspoon Shatavari powder and 1 teaspoon Amla powder in a glass of cool water or aloe vera juice. Drink on an empty stomach every morning.

remedies.title: Cooling Yoga & Pranayama
remedies.description: Gentle, non-competitive yoga like Moon Salutations and forward bends, paired with Sheetali (cooling breath), pacifies Pitta intensity.
remedies.howTo: Practice 20 minutes of restorative yoga. Then sit comfortably, curl your tongue into a tube, inhale through the tongue, close the mouth, and exhale through the nose. Repeat 15 times.

remedies.title: Aloe Vera Juice
remedies.description: Aloe vera is one of the best Pitta-pacifying herbs. It cools the digestive tract, reduces heartburn, and purifies the blood.
remedies.howTo: Drink 2 tablespoons of pure aloe vera juice mixed with water on an empty stomach every morning. Avoid if pregnant.

remedies.title: Sandalwood & Rose Face Pack
remedies.description: A cooling face treatment that soothes Pitta-related skin inflammation, redness, and acne. Rose and sandalwood are naturally cooling.
remedies.howTo: Mix 1 teaspoon sandalwood powder with rose water to form a paste. Apply to the face for 15 minutes. Rinse with cool water. Use 2-3 times per week.

remedies.title: Moonlight & Nature Walks
remedies.description: Spending time in cool moonlight and near water bodies naturally pacifies Pitta. Evening walks in gardens or by a lake are deeply therapeutic.
remedies.howTo: Take a 20-minute walk in the evening after sunset, preferably near water or in a garden. Avoid intense midday sun.

Kapha.summary: Kapha imbalance leads to sluggishness, weight gain, congestion, and lethargy. These remedies focus on stimulation, warmth, and lightness.

remedies.title: Light & Spicy Foods
remedies.description: Favour pungent, bitter, and astringent tastes. Include ginger, black pepper, turmeric, leafy greens, and light grains like millet. Avoid heavy, oily, and sweet foods.
remedies.howTo: Start meals with a small piece of fresh ginger sprinkled with lemon juice and salt. Choose steamed or lightly sautéed vegetables over creamy dishes.

remedies.title: Turmeric-Ginger-Pepper Tea
remedies.description: A powerful warming tea that boosts metabolism, clears congestion, and ignites the digestive fire (Agni) — perfect for sluggish Kapha.
remedies.howTo: Boil 1 cup water with ½ teaspoon turmeric, 1-inch ginger, and 3 black peppercorns for 5 minutes. Strain and add a squeeze of lemon. Drink 2-3 times daily.

remedies.title: Dry Brushing (Garshana)
remedies.description: Unlike oil massage, Kapha benefits from dry brushing which stimulates lymphatic drainage, breaks up stagnation, and energizes the body.
remedies.howTo: Using raw silk gloves or a natural bristle brush, vigorously brush your skin in upward strokes toward the heart for 5-10 minutes before showering.

remedies.title: Trikatu (Three Peppers)
remedies.description: A classical Ayurvedic formula of black pepper, long pepper, and ginger that boosts metabolism, clears mucus, and strengthens digestion.
remedies.howTo: Mix ¼ teaspoon Trikatu powder with 1 teaspoon honey. Take before meals to kindle the digestive fire. Use for 2-3 weeks at a time.

remedies.title: Vigorous Exercise
remedies.description: Kapha needs dynamic movement to combat sluggishness. High-intensity workouts, brisk walks, jogging, or Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutations) are ideal.
remedies.howTo: Practice 12 rounds of Surya Namaskar every morning, followed by 15 minutes of brisk walking or jogging. Exercise before 10 AM for best results.

remedies.title: Honey & Warm Water
remedies.description: Honey is considered the best remedy for Kapha in Ayurveda. It scrapes excess mucus and fat from the body when taken with warm water.
remedies.howTo: Mix 1 tablespoon of raw honey in a glass of warm (not hot) water. Add a squeeze of lemon. Drink first thing every morning on an empty stomach.

remedies.title: Kapalabhati Pranayama
remedies.description: A vigorous breathing technique that clears nasal passages, boosts energy, improves mental clarity, and burns off Kapha lethargy.
remedies.howTo: Sit upright. Take a deep breath in, then exhale forcefully through the nose while pulling your navel toward the spine. Passive inhale. Repeat 30 times, rest, and do 3 rounds.

remedies.title: Eucalyptus & Camphor Steam
remedies.description: Steam inhalation with eucalyptus and camphor clears congestion, opens sinuses, and energizes Kapha's heavy respiratory system.
remedies.howTo: Boil water in a large bowl. Add 3-4 drops of eucalyptus oil and a pinch of camphor. Cover your head with a towel and inhale the steam for 10 minutes.
